richiami.difetto: The propeller shafts have insufficient strength due to insufficient press-fitting length of the universal joints into the tubes. As a result, cracks can develop in these areas during use, leading the propeller shaft to break. This can cause unexpected loss of control of the vehicle, increasing the risk of accidents and injuries. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Distributor · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: 24/06/2024
richiami.titolo: The propeller shafts have insufficient strength due to insufficient press-fitting length of the universal joints into the tubes.

traduzione.difetto: Gli alberi propulsori presentano insufficiente resistenza a causa della lunghezza insufficiente di pressaggio delle giunzioni universali nei tubi. Di conseguenza, possono svilupparsi crepe in queste aree durante l'uso, provocando la rottura dell'albero propulsore. Ciò può causare una perdita imprevista di controllo del veicolo, aumentando il rischio di incidenti e lesioni. Il prodotto non risponde al Regolamento sulla approvazione e sorveglianza del mercato dei veicoli a motore e dei loro rimorchi, nonché dei sistemi, componenti e unità tecniche separate destinati a tali veicoli.
traduzione.rimedio: Tipo di operatore economico che ha adottato misura(i) notificata(e): Distributore · Categoria della misura(i): Ritiro del prodotto dagli utenti finali · Data di entrata in vigore: 24/06/2024
traduzione.titolo: Gli alberi propulsori presentano insufficiente resistenza a causa della lunghezza insufficiente di pressaggio delle giunzioni universali nei tubi.

richiami.difetto: Incorrect software in the engine control module can lead to malfunctions of the automatic transmission that could affect vehicle emissions. There may be no communication of the defect to the driver (MIL) and the defect would not be visible to a scanning diagnostic tool during servicing. There is no known concern affecting the safety of the automatic transmission in relation to this campaign but vehicle emissions may not be to the manufacturers specification.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and reprogram the Electronic Control Module with latest level software.
richiami.titolo: AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION MALFUNCTION MAY AFFECT VEHICLE EMISSIONS

richiami.difetto: The steering column has no electrical connection to ground other than the spiral cable. In the event that the spiral cable is damaged the airbag warning light will illuminate. If the customer ignores the warning light and continues to drive for extended periods electrostatic charge may be discharged through the electrical circuit of the drivers airbag. In an extreme case this discharge could be sufficient to trigger an unintended deployment of the driver airbag.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and fit a slip ring to the steering column on all potentially affected vehicles.
richiami.titolo: DRIVER'S AIRBAG MAY DEPLOY

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that due to a manufacturing error at the airbag manufacturer the chemical composition of the initiator (the compound that triggers the airbag deployment) of a limited number of passenger airbag inflators may not be to specification.  Therefore it is possible that an affected airbag may not deploy in the event of an accident.
richiami.rimedio: Recall all affected vehicles to have the affected airbags replace with a new quality assured component.

richiami.difetto: Some vehicles may have an incorrectly assembled front seat belt with the right hand seat belt fitted on the left hand side or vice versa. This could cause the seat belt upper anchorage to be used at an incorrect angle; making it difficult for the customer to apply the seatbelt or slowing the retraction speed when removing the belt. In an extreme case the front seat belt may not restrain the front seat passenger.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and where necessary replace the front seat belts.
richiami.titolo: ANCHORAGE POINT MAY BE INCORRECTLY POSITIONED AND MAY NOT RESTRAIN THE PASSENGER

richiami.difetto: If the water pump fails in the hybrid power train the MIL will illuminate. The Owner's Manual informs the driver to take the vehicle to a dealership or the transmission could be compromised. However the engine logic will stop the engine after approximately five minutes of driving. As this would be an unexpected event the driver and occupants could be left in a dangerous situation.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and reprogram the ECU to enable a limp-home mode which will allow the vehicle to get to a dealership under reduced power.
richiami.titolo: ENGINE MAY STALL

richiami.difetto: Due to incorrect software in the Direct Adaptive Steering  control unit the steering wheel may be off centre and driver's may interpret this as the  steering pulling to one side. The turning circle may also be increased.
richiami.rimedio: On affected vehicles reprogramme the  Direct Adaptive Steering  control unit
richiami.titolo: STEERING / DIRECTIONAL CONTROL MAY BE AFFECTED

richiami.titolo: null Because of a faulty gasket on the timing chain tensioner, motor oil may leak out and drip onto the road leading to a skid risk for other road users.

richiami.difetto: Due to insufficient sealing  of the timing chain tensioner gasket the timing chain tensioner may loosen and an oil leak may occur from the engine.  If t the vehicle continues to be driven engine oil could leak onto the road and the engine might stall due to low oil level.  In an extreme case and in the presence of an ignition source there may be an increased risk of a fire.
richiami.rimedio: On affected vehicles  replace the timing chain tensioner gasket with new.
richiami.titolo: OIL MAY LEAK ENGINE MAY STALL

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that under certain circumstances the throttle position sensor may send an error signal to the Engine Control Module (ECM). As a result the ECM may not operate as intended and the vehicle may accelerate gradually without the driver operating the throttle pedal. However this acceleration can be overridden by application of the brakes.
richiami.rimedio: Recall all affected vehicles to install new software of the ECM.
richiami.titolo: UNINTENDED ACCELERATION

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that due to an issue during the casting process of the front of the transmission casing the casting may become cracked during the release phase of the operation. If the vehicle is driven at high speed in this condition the crack can grow and cause a vibration. In an extreme case the transmission may detach from the vehicle.
richiami.rimedio: Recall all affected vehicles to inspect the transmission casing for cracks and replace any transmission are found to be cracked.
richiami.titolo: UNDER EXTREME CIRCUMSTANCES TRANSMISSION MAY DETACH

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that due to a software error the traction motor inverter may incorrectly diagnose communication between the inverter and the transmission control module (TCM). This can cause the inverter system to suddenly shut down. If the vehicle is being driven in Electric Vehicle (EV i.e. engine off) the power to the electric motor may be cut resulting in the vehicle coming to a sudden stop.
richiami.rimedio: Recall all affected vehicles to install new software for the traction motor inverter control module.
richiami.titolo: VEHICLE MAY CUT OUT
